<thought>Using the valid functional group name “sulfonamides” (and “acyl chloride” for the sulfonyl chloride that is broken), I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide. This should return the template ID and its SMARTS, from which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
